html_source: George Cruikshank's 1845 illustration of the Battle of Ross in William Hamilton Maxwell's History of the Irish Rebellion in 1798, held in the British Library. The mocking caption reads, "Come on Boys her mouth's stopt." Source: Wikimedia Commons.
